mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2.5% per annum signals an accommodative monetary policy environment that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return distribution in periods with FEDFUNDS < 2.5% shows no significant positive bias compared to the overall distribution (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a 3-month window, it indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger equity sell-offs, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0% over a 3-month period.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential housing starts (HOUST) and consumer credit (RSAFS) by more than 3% in the prior month indicate weakening private sector demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST decline > 3% and RSAFS decline > 3% in 1 month
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by >3% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 100, supply chain disruption risk increases, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO is below 100.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflationary pressure that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in real GDP (GDPC1) above the 10-year moving average indicates strong economic growth, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return distribution in periods with GDPC1 above 10-year MA shows no significant positive bias compared to the overall distribution (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 0.2 percentage points and 1% respectively in the prior month indicate labor market stress, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rise > 0.2pp and PAYEMS decline > 1% in 1 month
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp and PAYEMS falls > 1% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS > 3.0% and rising), the increased cost of capital leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when the regime is 'monetary tightening cycle'.
